  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The guard discards per-command `git -c remote.origin.url=...` overrides, so pushes using the literal remote `origin` can write to another repository without the foreign-destination confirmation.
  WHY: Git applies the override at push time while the guard treats `origin` as trusted; severity was reported as BLOCKER by minimax and MAJOR by the other reviewers.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1320-1323, 1399 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A deletion or tag-only push to a foreign remote can add an empty string to `bulk_reasons`, producing a confirmation message with a leading comma.
  WHY: The reviewers report that the empty string is included in the sorted union with `unverified_destinations`, making the message malformed even though confirmation is still requested.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; same in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard consumes but does not record `git -c remote.origin.url=<URL>`, allowing pushes to a different repository through the trusted literal remote `origin` without confirmation.
  WHY: Git applies the override at runtime, while the foreign-destination check sees `origin` and is bypassed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A deletion-only or tag-only push to a foreign remote can produce a confirmation message with a leading comma.
  WHY: The empty `bulk` value is included in the sorted union with `unverified_destinations`, resulting in malformed message formatting.

  PROBLEM: The guard discards `git -c remote.origin.url=...` overrides, allowing a push through `origin` to target another repository without confirmation.
  WHY: The parser consumes and discards the override, then classifies the literal `origin` as trusted.
- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py `_guarded_git_invocations` lines 368-389 (the `-c` handler that drops the value) and/or _push_targets lines 425-517 (the parser that derives `remote_value` from arguments only, never from `git -c` overrides), plus its workflow-templates/ twin.
  Evidence of absence: The last_run_diff and full PR diff add `target.remote` tracking for `--repo` and positional remotes and route them through the foreign-remote confirmation; they do not extend the same tracking to `git -c remote.X.url=...` overrides, which `git push` accepts and applies per-invocation. The `_evaluate_bash` foreign-remote check at line 1323 keys on `target.remote`, which is empty for `git -c`-override pushes. No test in tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py exercises `git -c remote.origin.url=...` push (only one test mentions `remote.origin.url`, at line 1182, as part of a fixture description).
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
